    say 'https://example' ~~ / http | https /;

--- regexes/alternations/exercises/http-or-https/solution
    say 'https://example' ~~ / https? /; # ｢https｣

--- regexes/alternations/exercises/word-or-digit/solution
    say 'item 5' ~~ / cat | \d /;

    say 'catdog' ~~ / cat | catdog /; # ｢catdog｣

--- regexes/alternations/longest-token
    say 'catdog' ~~ / cat || catdog /; # ｢cat｣

--- regexes/anchors/exercises/starts-with/solution
    say so '3 apples' ~~ /^ \d /;

--- regexes/anchors/exercises/whole-string/solution
    say so 'hello' ~~ /^ <[a..z]>+ $/;

--- regexes/anchors/exercises/whole-word/solution
    say 'this is fine' ~~ /<< is >>/;

--- regexes/anchors/string-anchors
    say so 'http://example' ~~ /^ http /; # True
    say so 'see http://x'   ~~ /^ http /; # False

--- regexes/anchors/string-anchors
    say so 'hello'       ~~ /^ hello $/; # True
    say so 'hello world' ~~ /^ hello $/; # False

--- regexes/anchors/string-anchors
    say so '2025' ~~ /^ \d+ $/; # True
    say so '20a5' ~~ /^ \d+ $/; # False

--- regexes/anchors/string-anchors
    say so "cat\ndog" ~~ /^  dog  $/;  # False
    say so "cat\ndog" ~~ /^^ dog $$/;  # True

--- regexes/anchors/word-boundaries
    say 'the cat sat' ~~ /<< cat >>/;    # ｢cat｣
    say so 'category'  ~~ /<< cat >>/;   # False

--- regexes/anchors/word-boundaries
    say 'the cat sat' ~~ /« cat »/;  # ｢cat｣
    say so 'category'  ~~ /« cat »/;  # False

--- regexes/assertions/exercises/bare-number/solution
    say '5 and $9' ~~ / <!after '$'> \d+ /;

--- regexes/assertions/exercises/not-followed/solution
    say so '50 dollars' ~~ / \d+ >> <!before '%'> /;

--- regexes/assertions/exercises/percent-number/solution
    say '(42)' ~~ / <?after '('> \d+ <?before ')'> /;

--- regexes/assertions/exercises/whole-dollar/solution
    say '$50' ~~ / <?after '$'> \d+ >> <!before '.'> /;

--- regexes/assertions/lookahead
    say '100 dollars' ~~ / \d+ <?before ' dollars'> /; # ｢100｣

--- regexes/assertions/lookahead
    say so '100 euro'    ~~ / \d+ <?before ' euro'> /; # True
    say so '100 dollars' ~~ / \d+ <?before ' euro'> /; # False

--- regexes/assertions/lookahead
    say so 'cats' ~~ / cat <!before \d> /; # True
    say so 'cat5' ~~ / cat <!before \d> /; # False

--- regexes/assertions/lookbehind
    if '$100' ~~ / <?after '$'> \d+ / {
        say $/; # ｢100｣
    }

--- regexes/captures/exercises/capture-the-year/solution
    if 'report.txt' ~~ / (\w+) '.' (\w+) / {
        say ~$0;
        say ~$1;
    }

--- regexes/captures/exercises/city-and-country/solution
    if 'London-UK' ~~ / $<city>=(\w+) '-' $<country>=(\w+) / {
        say ~$<city>;
        say ~$<country>;
    }

--- regexes/captures/exercises/initial-and-surname/solution
    if 'J Smith' ~~ / $<initial>=(\w) ' ' $<surname>=(\w+) / {
        say ~$<surname>;
    }

--- regexes/captures/exercises/swap-words/solution
    if 'Grace Hopper' ~~ / (\w+) ' ' (\w+) / {
        say "$1, $0";
    }

--- regexes/captures/named
    if 'Anna:30' ~~ / $<name>=(\w+) ':' $<age>=(\d+) / {
        say $<name>; # ｢Anna｣
        say $<age>;  # ｢30｣
    }

--- regexes/captures/named
    if 'x=5' ~~ / $<key>=(\w+) '=' $<value>=(\w+) / {
        say "key is $<key>, value is $<value>"; # key is x, value is 5
    }

--- regexes/captures/non-capturing
    say 'abccc' ~~ / abc ** 3 /; # ｢abccc｣

--- regexes/captures/non-capturing
    say 'abcabcabc' ~~ / [ abc ] ** 3 /; # ｢abcabcabc｣

--- regexes/captures/non-capturing
    if 'foo=42' ~~ / (\w+) '=' (\d+) / {
        say $0; # ｢foo｣
        say $1; # ｢42｣
    }

--- regexes/captures/non-capturing
    if 'the foo=42' ~~ / [ \w+ \s ]? (\w+) '=' (\d+) / {
        say $0; # ｢foo｣
        say $1; # ｢42｣
    }

--- regexes/captures/positional
    if '2025-06' ~~ / (\d+) '-' (\d+) / {
        say $0; # ｢2025｣
        say $1; # ｢06｣
    }

--- regexes/captures/positional
    if 'hello world' ~~ / (\w+) ' ' (\w+) / {
        say "$1 $0"; # world hello
    }

--- regexes/captures/positional
    if '2025-06' ~~ / (\d+) '-' (\d+) / {
        say $/[0];    # ｢2025｣
        say $/[1];    # ｢06｣
        say $/.elems; # 2
    }

--- regexes/creating-grammars/exercises/parse-a-pair/solution
    grammar FullName {
        token TOP   { <first> ' ' <last> }
        token first { \w+ }
        token last  { \w+ }
    }

    say FullName.parse('Grace Hopper')<last>;

--- regexes/creating-grammars/exercises/parse-a-time/solution
    grammar Time {
        token TOP    { <hour> ':' <minute> ':' <second> }
        token hour   { \d ** 2 }
        token minute { \d ** 2 }
        token second { \d ** 2 }
    }

    say Time.parse('09:30:45')<second>;

--- regexes/creating-grammars/exercises/parse-greeting/solution
    grammar Hashtag {
        token TOP { '#' <tag> }
        token tag { \w+ }
    }

    say Hashtag.parse('#raku')<tag>;

--- regexes/creating-grammars/exercises/parse-hashtag/solution
    grammar Hashtag {
        token TOP  { <tag> }
        token tag  { '#' <word> }
        token word { \w+ }
    }

    say Hashtag.parse('#raku')<tag><word>;

--- regexes/creating-grammars/parse-method
    grammar Pair {
        token TOP   { <key> '=' <value> }
        token key   { \w+ }
        token value { \w+ }
    }

    my $m = Pair.parse('x=5');
    say $m<key>;   # ｢x｣
    say $m<value>; # ｢5｣

--- regexes/grammar-inheritance/exercises/inherit-a-grammar/solution
    grammar Animal {
        token TOP   { <sound> }
        token sound { \w+ }
    }

    grammar Dog is Animal {
        token sound { 'woof' }
    }

    grammar Cat is Animal {
        token sound { 'meow' }
    }

    say Dog.parse('woof').defined;
    say Cat.parse('meow').defined;
    say Dog.parse('meow').defined;

--- regexes/grammar-inheritance/exercises/proto-bool/solution
    grammar Bool {
        token TOP { <bool> }

        proto token bool {*}
        token bool:sym<true>  { 'true' }
        token bool:sym<false> { 'false' }
    }

    say Bool.parse('true').defined;
    say Bool.parse('false').defined;
    say Bool.parse('unknown').defined;

--- regexes/grammar-inheritance/exercises/proto-number/solution
    grammar Number {
        token TOP { <number> }

        proto token number {*}
        token number:sym<dec> { \d+ }
        token number:sym<hex> { '0x' <[0..9a..f]>+ }
    }

    say Number.parse('0xff').defined;

--- regexes/grammar-inheritance/grammars-are-classes
    grammar Base {
        token TOP      { <greeting> }
        token greeting { 'hi' }
    }

    grammar Loud is Base {
        token greeting { 'HI' }
    }

    say Loud.parse('HI').defined; # True
    say Base.parse('hi').defined; # True

--- regexes/grammar-inheritance/proto-tokens
    grammar Number {
        token TOP { <number> }

        proto token number {*}
        token number:sym<int>   { \d+ }
        token number:sym<float> { \d+ '.' \d+ }
    }

    say Number.parse('42').defined;   # True
    say Number.parse('3.14').defined; # True

--- regexes/literals
    say 'the cat sat' ~~ /cat/; # ｢cat｣

--- regexes/literals/character-classes
    say 'grey' ~~ / gr <[ae]> y /; # ｢grey｣
    say 'gray' ~~ / gr <[ae]> y /; # ｢gray｣

--- regexes/literals/character-classes
    say 'a1b2' ~~ / <[0..9]> /; # ｢1｣

--- regexes/literals/character-classes
    say 'stop!' ~~ / <-[a..z]> /; # ｢!｣

--- regexes/literals/exercises/a-vowel/solution
    say 'Hello' ~~ / <[aeiou]> /;

--- regexes/literals/exercises/digit-class/solution
    say '  @x7' ~~ / <[a..z 0..9]> /;

--- regexes/literals/exercises/first-non-digit/solution
    say '42abc' ~~ /\D/;

--- regexes/literals/exercises/match-a-word/solution
    say 'I love Raku' ~~ / 'love Raku' /;

--- regexes/literals/literal-text
    say 'the cat sat' ~~ /cat/; # ｢cat｣
    say 'Hello'       ~~ /ell/; # ｢ell｣

--- regexes/literals/literal-text
    say ('the cat sat' ~~ /dog/);       # Nil
    say ('the cat sat' ~~ /dog/).Bool;  # False

--- regexes/literals/literal-text
    say 'Hello' ~~ / ell /; # ｢ell｣

--- regexes/literals/literal-text
    say 'a b'       ~~ / 'a b' /; # ｢a b｣
    say 'price: $5' ~~ / '$' /;   # ｢$｣

--- regexes/literals/predefined-classes
    say 'order 66' ~~ /\d/; # ｢6｣
    say 'a_b'      ~~ /\w/; # ｢a｣
    say '  hi'     ~~ /\s/; # ｢ ｣

--- regexes/literals/predefined-classes
    say '  hi' ~~ /\S/; # ｢h｣

--- regexes/literals/predefined-classes
    say 'abc' ~~ /./; # ｢a｣

--- regexes/make-and-made/exercises/extract-the-number/solution
    grammar Weight {
        token TOP    { <number> 'kg' { make $<number>.Int } }
        token number { \d+ }
    }

    say Weight.parse('5kg').made;

--- regexes/make-and-made/exercises/multiply-a-pair/solution
    grammar Product {
        token TOP { <a> '*' <b> { make $<a>.Int * $<b>.Int } }
        token a   { \d+ }
        token b   { \d+ }
    }

    say Product.parse('4*5').made;

--- regexes/make-and-made/exercises/reverse-the-words/solution
    grammar Phrase {
        token TOP  { <word> [ ' ' <word> ]* { make $<word>».made.join(' ') } }
        token word { \w+ { make $/.flip } }
    }

    say Phrase.parse('hello world').made;

--- regexes/make-and-made/exercises/word-length/solution
    grammar Word {
        token TOP  { <word> { make $<word>.flip } }
        token word { \w+ }
    }

    say Word.parse('hello').made;

--- regexes/make-and-made/make-made
    grammar Sum {
        token TOP { <a> '+' <b> { make $<a>.Int + $<b>.Int } }
        token a   { \d+ }
        token b   { \d+ }
    }

    say Sum.parse('2+3').made; # 5

--- regexes/make-and-made/match-tree
    grammar Pair {
        token TOP   { <key> '=' <value> }
        token key   { \w+ }
        token value { \d+ }
    }

    my $m = Pair.parse('x=5');
    say $m<key>;   # ｢x｣
    say $m<value>; # ｢5｣

--- regexes/matching/exercises/did-it-match/solution
    say so 'Hello, World' ~~ /World/;

--- regexes/matching/exercises/matched-text/solution
    'database' ~~ /base/;
    say $/.Str;

--- regexes/matching/exercises/where-digit/solution
    my $m = 'abc9x2z' ~~ /\d/;
    say $m.from;
    say $m.to;

--- regexes/matching/match-object
    my $m = 'concatenate' ~~ /cat/;
    say $m.Str; # cat
    say ~$m;    # cat

--- regexes/matching/match-object
    my $m = 'room 7 left' ~~ /\d/;
    say $m.Str;  # 7
    say $m.from; # 5
    say $m.to;   # 6

--- regexes/matching/match-object
    my $m = 'abc' ~~ /z/;
    say $m.defined; # False

--- regexes/matching/smartmatch
    say 'the cat sat' ~~ m/cat/;  # ｢cat｣
    say 'the cat sat' ~~ rx/cat/; # ｢cat｣

--- regexes/matching/smartmatch
    say so 'the cat sat' ~~ /cat/; # True
    say so 'the cat sat' ~~ /dog/; # False

--- regexes/matching/smartmatch
    if 'the cat sat' ~~ /cat/ {
        say 'found it';   # found it
    }

--- regexes/quantifiers/exercises/frugal-match/solution
    say 'say "hi" and "bye"' ~~ / '"' .+? '"' /;

--- regexes/quantifiers/exercises/optional-sign/solution
    say '-42' ~~ / '-'? \d+ /;

--- regexes/quantifiers/exercises/range-quantifier/solution
    say 'abcdef' ~~ / \w ** 2..4 /;

--- regexes/quantifiers/exercises/three-digits/solution
    say 'abc12345' ~~ / \d ** 2..4 /;

--- regexes/quantifiers/greedy-frugal
    say '<a><b>' ~~ / '<' .+ '>' /; # ｢<a><b>｣

--- regexes/quantifiers/greedy-frugal
    say '<a><b>' ~~ / '<' .+? '>' /; # ｢<a>｣

--- regexes/quantifiers/star-plus-question
    say 'aaah' ~~ / a+ /; # ｢aaa｣

--- regexes/quantifiers/star-plus-question
    say 'colour' ~~ / colou*r /; # ｢colour｣
    say 'color'  ~~ / colou*r /; # ｢color｣

--- regexes/quantifiers/star-plus-question
    say 'colour' ~~ / colou?r /; # ｢colour｣
    say 'color'  ~~ / colou?r /; # ｢color｣

--- regexes/quantifiers/star-plus-question
    say 'order 66' ~~ / \d+ /; # ｢66｣

--- regexes/quantifiers/times-quantifier
    say '2025' ~~ / \d ** 4 /; # ｢2025｣

--- regexes/quantifiers/times-quantifier
    say '12345' ~~ / \d ** 2..3 /; # ｢123｣

--- regexes/substitution/captures-in-replacement
    my $d = '2025-06';
    $d ~~ s/ (\d+) '-' (\d+) /$1\/$0/;
    say $d; # 06/2025

--- regexes/substitution/captures-in-replacement
    my $name = 'Doe, Jane';
    $name ~~ s/ $<last>=(\w+) ', ' $<first>=(\w+) /$<first> $<last>/;
    say $name; # Jane Doe

--- regexes/substitution/exercises/censor-word/solution
    my $s = 'secret secret plan';
    $s ~~ s:g/secret/***/;
    say $s;

--- regexes/substitution/exercises/lowercase-letters/solution
    my $s = 'RAKU';
    $s ~~ tr/A..Z/a..z/;
    say $s;

--- regexes/substitution/exercises/mask-digits/solution
    my $orig = 'PIN 1234';
    say S:g/\d/#/ given $orig;
    say $orig;

--- regexes/substitution/exercises/reformat-date/solution
    my $d = '2025-06-15';
    $d ~~ s/ (\d+) '-' (\d+) '-' (\d+) /$2\/$1\/$0/;
    say $d;

--- regexes/substitution/s-operator
    my $s = 'hello world';
    $s ~~ s/world/Raku/;
    say $s; # hello Raku

--- regexes/substitution/s-operator
    my $s = 'a-b-c';
    $s ~~ s:g/'-'/_/;
    say $s; # a_b_c

--- regexes/substitution/s-operator
    my $orig = 'color';
    say S:g/o/0/ given $orig; # c0l0r
    say $orig;                # color

--- regexes/substitution/s-operator
    my $orig = 'color';
    say $orig.subst('o', '0', :g); # c0l0r
    say $orig;                     # color

--- regexes/substitution/transliteration
    my $s = 'hello';
    $s ~~ tr/a..z/A..Z/;
    say $s; # HELLO

--- regexes/substitution/transliteration
    my $s = 'abcabc';
    $s ~~ tr/abc/xyz/;
    say $s; # xyzxyz

--- regexes/tokens-and-rules/exercises/spaced-assignment/solution
    grammar Assign {
        rule TOP    { <key> '=' <value> }
        token key   { \w+ }
        token value { \w+ }
    }

    say Assign.parse('x = 5').defined;

--- regexes/tokens-and-rules/exercises/spaced-rule/solution
    grammar Phrase {
        rule TOP   { <word> <word> <word> }
        token word { \w+ }
    }

    say Phrase.parse('the quick fox').defined;

--- regexes/tokens-and-rules/exercises/token-instead/solution
    my regex r { \d+ '5' }
    my token t { \d+ '5' }

    say so '12345' ~~ / <r> /;
    say so '12345' ~~ / <t> /;

--- regexes/tokens-and-rules/rule-sigspace
    grammar WithToken {
        token TOP    { <first> <second> }
        token first  { \w+ }
        token second { \w+ }
    }

    say WithToken.parse('foo bar').defined; # False

--- regexes/tokens-and-rules/rule-sigspace
    grammar WithRule {
        rule TOP     { <first> <second> }
        token first  { \w+ }
        token second { \w+ }
    }

    say WithRule.parse('foo bar').defined; # True

--- regexes/tokens-and-rules/three-kinds
    my regex r { \w+ 'b' }
    say so 'aaab' ~~ / <r> /; # True

--- regexes/tokens-and-rules/three-kinds
    my token t { \w+ 'b' }
    say so 'aaab' ~~ / <t> /; # False

--- regexes/what-is-a-grammar/exercises/named-token/solution
    my regex word { \w+ }

    if 'hello world' ~~ / <word> / {
        say $<word>;
    }

--- regexes/what-is-a-grammar/exercises/reuse-a-token/solution
    my regex word { \w+ }

    if 'cat dog' ~~ / <word> ' ' <word> / {
        say $<word>[0];
        say $<word>[1];
    }

--- regexes/what-is-a-grammar/exercises/year-token/solution
    my regex year  { \d ** 4 }
    my regex month { \d ** 2 }

    if '2025-06' ~~ / <year> '-' <month> / {
        say $<year>;
        say $<month>;
    }

--- regexes/what-is-a-grammar/named-regexes
    my regex number { \d+ }

    if '42 cats' ~~ / <number> / {
        say $<number>; # ｢42｣
    }

--- regexes/what-is-a-grammar/named-regexes
    my regex num { \d+ }

    if '3-4' ~~ / <num> '-' <num> / {
        say $<num>[0]; # ｢3｣
        say $<num>[1]; # ｢4｣
    }

--- bg/advanced/colon-calls
    my @a = 3, 1, 2;

    say @a.sort({ $^b <=> $^a }); # скоби около блока
    say @a.sort: { $^b <=> $^a }; # двоеточие — няма затваряща скоба за съвпадение

--- bg/advanced/integers/number-bases
    say 0xFF;   # 255  — шестнадесетична (основа 16)
    say 0b1010; # 10   — двоична (основа 2)
    say 0o17;   # 15   — осмична (основа 8)

--- bg/advanced/metaoperators/more
    say 3 != 4;      # True
    say 'a' !eq 'b'; # True  — не са равни като низове
    say 5 !%% 2;     # True  — 5 не се дели на 2

--- bg/advanced/metaoperators/more
    say 'a' ne 'b'; # True — същата проверка като 'a' !eq 'b'

--- bg/advanced/quoting/adverbs
    say q/result: {3 * 4}/;   # result: {3 * 4}  — обикновено q оставя блока непроменен
    say q:c/result: {3 * 4}/; # result: 12        — :c изпълнява блока

--- bg/advanced/quoting/q-qq-big-q
    say q{a\\b}; # a\b   — q колапсира екранираната обратна наклонена черта
    say Q{a\\b}; # a\\b  — Q запазва и двата символа

--- bg/advanced/whatever
    my @a = 10, 20, 30;
    say @a[*-1];        # 30  — * е дължината на масива, така че *-1 е последният индекс

    say (1..*).head(3); # (1 2 3)  — 1..* е отворен диапазон

--- bg/essentials/associatives/exercises/salary-raise/solution
    my %employee =
        full-name => 'Eliza Vents',
        department => 'Sales',
        salary => 3000;

    my $raise = 5; # в проценти

    %employee<salary> *= (1 + $raise / 100);
    say "New salary of %employee<full-name>: %employee<salary>";

--- bg/essentials/associatives/interpolating-hashes

    say "%data<FR>";
    say "%data<>";

    # Или:
    # say "%data{}";

--- bg/essentials/booleans/exercises/tables/solution
    say 'True && True е ', True && True; 
    say 'True && False е ', True && False;
    say 'False && True е ', False && True;
    say 'False && False е ', False && False;

    say 'True || True е ', True || True; 
    say 'True || False е ', True || False;
    say 'False || True е ', False || True;
    say 'False || False е ', False || False;

    say 'True ^^ True е ', True ^^ True; 
    say 'True ^^ False е ', True ^^ False;
    say 'False ^^ True е ', False ^^ True;
    say 'False ^^ False е ', False ^^ False;

--- bg/essentials/booleans/exercises/tables/solution
    say 'True && True е ' ~ (True && True);

--- bg/essentials/booleans/operations
    say False && True; # И
    say False || True; # ИЛИ
    say False ^^ True; # XOR

--- bg/essentials/built-in-functions-for-printing/exercises/compare-say-and-put/solution
    my Int $i = 42;
    say $i;
    put $i;

    my Rat $r = 3/4;
    say $r;
    put $r;

    my Num $n = 3e4;
    say $n;
    put $n;

    my Str $s = 'Raku';
    say $s;
    put $s;

    my @a = <this is an array>;
    # say @a.WHAT;
    say @a;
    put @a;

    my List $l = <this is a list>;
    # say $l.WHAT;
    say $l;
    put $l;

    my %h = A => 'alpha', B => 'beta';
    say %h;
    put %h;

--- bg/essentials/built-in-functions-for-printing/exercises/print-the-warning/solution

    if $age < 0 {
        note 'Въведохте отрицателно число!';
    }
    else {
        say "Вашата възраст е $age";
    }

--- bg/essentials/built-in-functions-for-printing/note
    my $x = 42;
    note "Текущата стойност на \$x е $x";

    my @data = 'alpha', 'beta', 'gamma';
    print @data;

    print "\n"; # За да разделите частите

    my %data = alpha => 1, beta => 2, gamma => 3;
    print %data;

--- bg/essentials/comments/embedded
    my $name;
    $name = #`[Очаква се потребителски вход тук] prompt 'Как се казваш? ';
    say $name;

--- bg/essentials/comments/multi-line
    my $name;
    #`( Ще помолим потребителя
    да въведе своето име първо и след това
    ще запазим въведеното в променлива. )

    $name = prompt 'Как се казвате? ';
    #`{ Програмата сега чака
    докато потребителят въведе името
    и натисне Enter. }

    say $name; #`( И сега можем да го отпечатаме )

--- bg/essentials/comments/single-line

    $name = prompt 'Как се казваш? ';
    say $name; # Сега виждаме името

--- bg/essentials/conditional-checks/comparing-strings
    say 'alpha' lt 'beta'; # Вярно
    say 'word' ne 'Word';  # Вярно
    say 'xyz' gt 'xvw';    # Вярно

--- bg/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/fizz-buzz/solution
    my $n = prompt 'Въведете число: ';

    print 'Fizz' if $n %% 3;
    print 'Buzz' if $n %% 5;
    print "\n";

--- bg/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/how-many-equal-numbers/solution
    my $n1 = prompt 'Въведете число 1: ';
    my $n2 = prompt 'Въведете число 2: ';
    my $n3 = prompt 'Въведете число 3: ';

    if $n1 == $n2 == $n3 {
        say 3;
    }
    elsif $n1 == $n2 || $n2 == $n3 || $n1 == $n3 {
        say 2;
    }
    else {
        say 0;
    }

--- bg/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/leap-year/solution
    say ?(100 % 3);    # Вярно
    say 100 % 3 != 0;  # Вярно

    say ?(100 %% 3);   # Невярно
    say 100 %% 3 != 0; # Невярно

--- bg/essentials/conditional-checks/if
    if 10 > 4 {
        say 'Математиката работи!';
    }

--- bg/essentials/conditional-checks/if
    my $x = 42;
    if 40 < $x < 45 {
        say "Даден е правилният отговор $x.";
    }

--- bg/essentials/conditional-checks/if
    say 'Начало';
    if False {
        say 'Това никога не се отпечатва.';
    }
    say 'Край';

--- bg/essentials/conditional-checks/unless
    my $broken = False;

    # ...Нещо може да направи $broken True тук...
        
    unless $broken {
        say "Не се притеснявай!";
        say "Бъди щастлив!";
    }

--- bg/oop/deleting
    mkdir 'reports';
    spurt 'reports/jan.txt', 'January';
    spurt 'reports/feb.txt', 'February';

    .unlink for 'reports'.IO.dir;   # изтриваме всеки елемент
    rmdir 'reports';                # сега директорията е празна
    say 'reports'.IO.e;             # False

--- bg/oop/directories
    spurt 'greeting.txt', 'hi';

    say 'greeting.txt'.IO.e; # True  — съществува ли?
    say 'greeting.txt'.IO.f; # True  — файл ли е?
    say 'greeting.txt'.IO.d; # False — директория ли е?

--- bg/oop/standard-streams

--- bg/oop/standard-streams

--- bg/paradigms/iterators/iterator-protocol
    my $it = <a b c>.iterator;
    loop {
        my $v := $it.pull-one;      # свързване, а не присвояване
        last if $v =:= IterationEnd;
        say $v;
    }

--- bg/paradigms/junctions/autothreading
    say so all(3, 7, 2) > 0;  # True  — всяка стойност е положителна
    say so all(3, -1, 2) > 0; # False — не всички са положителни
    say so none(1, 2, 3) == 5; # True — нито една от тях не е 5

--- bg/paradigms/promises/making-a-promise
    my $p = Promise.new;   # ново, неуредено обещание

    $p.keep(42);           # изпълняваме го със стойност
    say await $p;          # 42

--- bg/paradigms/promises/promise-status
    my $p = start { die 'boom' };
    try await $p;         # оставяме го да се уреди (и поглъщаме повторно хвърлената грешка)
    say $p.status;        # Broken
    say $p.cause.message; # boom

--- bg/paradigms/recursion/base-case
    sub countdown($n) {
        return if $n < 1;   # базов случай: спираме
        say $n;
        countdown($n - 1);  # рекурсивна стъпка
    }

    countdown(3);

--- bg/paradigms/supply-kinds/live-in-action
    my $supplier = Supplier.new;
    my $events   = $supplier.Supply;

    my $log = $events.tap(-> $v { say "log:   $v" });    # първият слушател се присъединява
    $supplier.emit('start');

    my $alert = $events.tap(-> $v { say "alert: $v" });  # присъединява се втори слушател
    $supplier.emit('warning');
    $supplier.emit('all clear');

    $log.close;                                          # първият слушател си тръгва
    $supplier.emit('stop');

--- de/advanced/colon-calls
    my @a = 3, 1, 2;

    say @a.sort({ $^b <=> $^a }); # Klammern um den Block
    say @a.sort: { $^b <=> $^a }; # Doppelpunkt — keine schließende Klammer nötig

--- de/advanced/integers/number-bases
    say 0xFF;   # 255  — hexadezimal (Basis 16)
    say 0b1010; # 10   — binaer (Basis 2)
    say 0o17;   # 15   — oktal (Basis 8)

--- de/advanced/metaoperators/more
    say 3 != 4;      # True
    say 'a' !eq 'b'; # True  — nicht gleich als Zeichenketten
    say 5 !%% 2;     # True  — 5 ist nicht teilbar durch 2

--- de/advanced/metaoperators/more
    say 'a' ne 'b'; # True — derselbe Test wie 'a' !eq 'b'

--- de/advanced/sets-bags-mixes/operations
    my $common = set(1, 2, 3) ∩ set(2, 3, 4);
    say $common;       # Set(2 3) — beachte, dass Sets ungeordnet sind
    say $common.elems; # 2
    say 2 ∈ $common;   # True

--- de/advanced/statement-prefixes/sink-quietly
    my $value;
    quietly {
        say $value + 1; # 1, ohne "uninitialized value"-Warnung
    }

--- de/advanced/whatever
    my @a = 10, 20, 30;
    say @a[*-1];        # 30  — * ist die Array-Länge, also ist *-1 der letzte Index

    say (1..*).head(3); # (1 2 3)  — 1..* ist ein offener Bereich

--- de/essentials/associatives/exercises/purchase-table/solution
    my @items = [
        {
            name => 'Stühle',
            price => 20.57,
            quantity => 4,
        },
        {
            name => 'Tische',
            price => 50.18,
            quantity => 1,
        }
    ];

    say "Artikel\tPreis\tMenge\tGesamt";
    for @items -> $item {
        my $total = $item<price> * $item<quantity>;
        say "$item<name>\t\$$item<price>\t$item<quantity>\t\$$total";
    }

--- de/essentials/associatives/exercises/salary-raise/solution

        full-name => 'Eliza Vents',
        department => 'Vertrieb',
        salary => 3000;

    my $raise = 5; # in Prozent

    %employee<salary> *= (1 + $raise / 100);
    say "Neues Gehalt von %employee<full-name>: %employee<salary>";

--- de/essentials/conditional-checks/elsif
    my $x = prompt 'Geben Sie die Zahl ein: ';
    if $x > 100 {
        say "$x ist größer als 100.";
    }
    elsif $x > 50 {
        say "$x ist größer als 50.";

        say "$x ist 25 oder kleiner.";
    }

--- de/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/fizz-buzz/solution
    my $n = prompt 'Gib eine Zahl ein: ';

--- de/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/how-many-equal-numbers/solution
    my $n1 = prompt 'Geben Sie Zahl 1 ein: ';
    my $n2 = prompt 'Geben Sie Zahl 2 ein: ';
    my $n3 = prompt 'Geben Sie Zahl 3 ein: ';

    if $n1 == $n2 == $n3 {
        say 3;
    }
    elsif $n1 == $n2 || $n2 == $n3 || $n1 == $n3 {
        say 2;
    }
    else {
        say 0;
    }

--- de/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/leap-year/solution
    my $year = prompt 'Jahr: ';

    if $year % 4 {
        say 'Gemeinjahr';
    }
    elsif $year % 100 {
        say 'Schaltjahr';
    }
    elsif $year % 400 {
        say 'Gemeinjahr';
    }
    else {
        say 'Schaltjahr';
    }

--- de/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/leap-year/solution
    my $year = prompt 'Jahr: ';

    say (($year %% 400) || (($year %% 4) && ($year % 100))) ?? 'Schaltjahr' !! 'Gemeinjahr';

--- de/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/leap-year/solution
    say ?(100 % 3);    # Wahr
    say 100 % 3 != 0;  # Wahr

    say ?(100 %% 3);   # Falsch
    say 100 %% 3 != 0; # Falsch

--- de/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/plural-ending/solution

    say "$n Datei{$ending} kopiert.";

--- eo/advanced/colon-calls
    my @a = 3, 1, 2;

    say @a.sort({ $^b <=> $^a }); # krampoj chirkaue de la bloko
    say @a.sort: { $^b <=> $^a }; # dupunkto — neniu ferma krampo por pari

--- eo/advanced/metaoperators/more
    say 3 != 4;      # True
    say 'a' !eq 'b'; # True  — ne-egalaj kiel ĉenoj
    say 5 !%% 2;     # True  — 5 ne estas dividebla per 2

--- eo/advanced/metaoperators/more
    say 'a' ne 'b'; # True — la sama testo kiel 'a' !eq 'b'

--- eo/advanced/ordered-containers/binding
    my $x = 10;
    my $y = $x; # simpla kopio

    $x = 20;
    say $y; # 10

--- eo/advanced/packages/namespaces
    module Counter {
        our $count = 0;  # paka variablo
        my  $secret = 42; # leksika, ne videbla ekstere
    }

    say $Counter::count; # 0

--- eo/advanced/quoting/adverbs
    say q/result: {3 * 4}/;   # result: {3 * 4}  — simpla q lasas la blokon netuŝita
    say q:c/result: {3 * 4}/; # result: 12        — :c ruligas la blokon

--- eo/advanced/quoting/q-qq-big-q
    say q{a\\b}; # a\b   — q kolapsas la eskapitan maldekstran streketon
    say Q{a\\b}; # a\\b  — Q konservas ambaŭ signojn

--- eo/advanced/scalar-containers/type-constraints
    my Int $int;

    $int = 123;       # rekte entjero
    say $int;

    $int = 100 + 23;  # la rezulto estas entjero
    say $int;

    $int = '123'.Int; # ĉeno konvertita al entjero
    say $int;

--- eo/advanced/sets-bags-mixes/operations
    my $common = set(1, 2, 3) ∩ set(2, 3, 4);
    say $common;       # Set(2 3) — notu, ke aroj estas neordigitaj
    say $common.elems; # 2
    say 2 ∈ $common;   # True

--- eo/advanced/strings
    say 'raku'.uc; # RAKU  — majuskloj
    say 'RAKU'.lc; # raku  — minuskloj
    say 'raku'.tc; # Raku  — titolusklo (unua litero majuskligita)

--- eo/advanced/strings/splitting
    say 'abc'.split('').elems;        # 5 — la tri literoj, plus malplena ĉeno ĉe ĉiu fino
    say 'abc'.split('', :skip-empty); # (a b c) — la adverbo :skip-empty forigas la malplenajn

--- eo/advanced/traits-pragmas/built-in-traits
    sub greet($name is copy) {
        $name = "dear $name";
        say "Hello, $name!";
    }

    my $who = 'Anna';
    greet($who); # Hello, dear Anna!
    say $who;    # Anna — la propra variablo de la vokanto restas netuŝita

--- eo/advanced/whatever
    my @a = 10, 20, 30;
    say @a[*-1];        # 30  — * estas la tabellongo, do *-1 estas la lasta indekso

    say (1..*).head(3); # (1 2 3)  — 1..* estas senfinpunkta amplekso

--- eo/essentials/associatives/exercises/salary-raise/solution

        full-name => 'Eliza Vents',
        department => 'Sales',
        salary => 3000;

    my $raise = 5; # en procentoj

    %employee<salary> *= (1 + $raise / 100);
    say "Nova salajro de %employee<full-name>: %employee<salary>";

--- eo/essentials/booleans/exercises/tables/solution
    say 'True && True estas ', True && True; 
    say 'True && False estas ', True && False;
    say 'False && True estas ', False && True;
    say 'False && False estas ', False && False;

    say 'True || True estas ', True || True; 
    say 'True || False estas ', True || False;
    say 'False || True estas ', False || True;
    say 'False || False estas ', False || False;

    say 'True ^^ True estas ', True ^^ True; 
    say 'True ^^ False estas ', True ^^ False;
    say 'False ^^ True estas ', False ^^ True;
    say 'False ^^ False estas ', False ^^ False;

--- eo/essentials/booleans/exercises/tables/solution
    say 'True && True estas ' ~ (True && True);

--- eo/essentials/booleans/operations
    say False && True; # KAJ
    say False || True; # AŬ
    say False ^^ True; # XOR

    print %data;

--- eo/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/fizz-buzz/solution

--- eo/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/how-many-equal-numbers/solution
    my $n1 = prompt 'Enigu numeron 1: ';
    my $n2 = prompt 'Enigu numeron 2: ';
    my $n3 = prompt 'Enigu numeron 3: ';

    if $n1 == $n2 == $n3 {
        say 3;
    }
    elsif $n1 == $n2 || $n2 == $n3 || $n1 == $n3 {
        say 2;
    }
    else {
        say 0;
    }

--- eo/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/leap-year/solution
    say ?(100 % 3);    # True
    say 100 % 3 != 0;  # True

    say ?(100 %% 3);   # False
    say 100 %% 3 != 0; # False

    say "$n dosiero{$ending} kopiita.";

--- eo/oop/deleting
    mkdir 'reports';
    spurt 'reports/jan.txt', 'January';
    spurt 'reports/feb.txt', 'February';

    .unlink for 'reports'.IO.dir;   # forigu ĉiun eron
    rmdir 'reports';                # nun la dosierujo estas malplena
    say 'reports'.IO.e;             # False

--- eo/oop/directories
    spurt 'greeting.txt', 'hi';

    say 'greeting.txt'.IO.e; # True  — ĉu ĝi ekzistas?
    say 'greeting.txt'.IO.f; # True  — ĉu ĝi estas dosiero?
    say 'greeting.txt'.IO.d; # False — ĉu ĝi estas dosierujo?

--- eo/paradigms/iterators/iterator-protocol
    my $it = <a b c>.iterator;
    loop {
        my $v := $it.pull-one;      # ligo, ne atribuo
        last if $v =:= IterationEnd;
        say $v;
    }

--- eo/paradigms/junctions/autothreading
    say so all(3, 7, 2) > 0;  # True  — ĉiu valoro estas pozitiva
    say so all(3, -1, 2) > 0; # False — ne ĉiuj estas pozitivaj
    say so none(1, 2, 3) == 5; # True — neniu el ili estas 5

--- eo/paradigms/promises/making-a-promise
    my $p = Promise.new;   # freŝa, ankoraŭ nedecidita promeso

    $p.keep(42);           # plenumu ĝin per valoro
    say await $p;          # 42

--- eo/paradigms/promises/promise-status
    my $p = start { die 'boom' };
    try await $p;         # lasu ĝin decidiĝi (kaj forglutu la reĵetitan eraron)
    say $p.status;        # Broken
    say $p.cause.message; # boom

--- eo/paradigms/recursion/base-case
    sub countdown($n) {
        return if $n < 1;   # baza kazo: haltu
        say $n;
        countdown($n - 1);  # rekursia paŝo
    }

    countdown(3);

--- eo/paradigms/supply-kinds/live-in-action
    my $supplier = Supplier.new;
    my $events   = $supplier.Supply;

    my $log = $events.tap(-> $v { say "log:   $v" });    # la unua aŭskultanto aliĝas
    $supplier.emit('start');

    my $alert = $events.tap(-> $v { say "alert: $v" });  # dua aŭskultanto aliĝas
    $supplier.emit('warning');
    $supplier.emit('all clear');

    $log.close;                                          # la unua aŭskultanto foriras
    $supplier.emit('stop');

--- es/advanced/colon-calls

    say @a.sort({ $^b <=> $^a }); # parentesis alrededor del bloque
    say @a.sort: { $^b <=> $^a }; # dos puntos — sin parentesis de cierre que emparejar

--- it/advanced/colon-calls
    my @a = 3, 1, 2;

    say @a.sort({ $^b <=> $^a }); # parentesi attorno al blocco
    say @a.sort: { $^b <=> $^a }; # due punti — nessuna parentesi di chiusura da abbinare

--- it/advanced/metaoperators/more
    say (1, 2, 3, 4) <<+>> (10, 20); # (11 22 13 24)  — 10, 20 si ripete come 10, 20, 10, 20

--- it/advanced/metaoperators/more
    say 3 != 4;      # True
    say 'a' !eq 'b'; # True  — non uguale come stringhe
    say 5 !%% 2;     # True  — 5 non è divisibile per 2

--- it/advanced/metaoperators/more
    say 'a' ne 'b'; # True — lo stesso test di 'a' !eq 'b'

--- it/advanced/sets-bags-mixes/operations
    my $common = set(1, 2, 3) ∩ set(2, 3, 4);
    say $common;       # Set(2 3) — nota che i set non sono ordinati
    say $common.elems; # 2
    say 2 ∈ $common;   # True

--- it/advanced/whatever
    my @a = 10, 20, 30;
    say @a[*-1];        # 30  — * è la lunghezza dell'array, quindi *-1 è l'ultimo indice

    say (1..*).head(3); # (1 2 3)  — 1..* è un intervallo aperto

--- it/essentials/associatives/exercises/purchase-table/solution
    my @items = [
        {
            name => 'Sedie',
            price => 20.57,
            quantity => 4,
        },
        {
            name => 'Tavoli',
            price => 50.18,
            quantity => 1,
        }
    ];

    say "Articolo\tPrezzo\tN\tTotale";
    for @items -> $item {
        my $total = $item<price> * $item<quantity>;
        say "$item<name>\t\$$item<price>\t$item<quantity>\t\$$total";
    }

        full-name => 'Eliza Vents',
        department => 'Sales',
        salary => 3000;

    my $raise = 5; # in percentuale

    %employee<salary> *= (1 + $raise / 100);
    say "Nuovo stipendio di %employee<full-name>: %employee<salary>";

--- it/essentials/conditional-checks/elsif
    my $x = prompt 'Inserisci il numero: ';
    if $x > 100 {
        say "$x è maggiore di 100.";
    }
    elsif $x > 50 {
        say "$x è maggiore di 50.";
    }
    elsif $x > 25 {
        say "$x è maggiore di 25.";
    }
    else {
        say "$x è 25 o minore.";
    }

--- it/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/fizz-buzz/solution
    my $n = prompt 'Inserisci un numero: ';

    print 'Fizz' if $n %% 3;
    print 'Buzz' if $n %% 5;
    print "\n";

--- it/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/how-many-equal-numbers/solution
    my $n1 = prompt 'Inserisci il numero 1: ';
    my $n2 = prompt 'Inserisci il numero 2: ';
    my $n3 = prompt 'Inserisci il numero 3: ';

    if $n1 == $n2 == $n3 {
        say 3;
    }
    elsif $n1 == $n2 || $n2 == $n3 || $n1 == $n3 {
        say 2;
    }
    else {
        say 0;
    }

--- it/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/leap-year/solution
    my $year = prompt 'Anno: ';

    if $year % 4 {
        say 'Anno comune';
    }
    elsif $year % 100 {
        say 'Anno bisestile';
    }
    elsif $year % 400 {
        say 'Anno comune';
    }
    else {
        say 'Anno bisestile';
    }

--- it/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/leap-year/solution
    my $year = prompt 'Anno: ';

    say (($year %% 400) || (($year %% 4) && ($year % 100))) ?? 'Anno bisestile' !! 'Anno comune';

--- it/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/leap-year/solution
    say ?(100 % 3);    # True
    say 100 % 3 != 0;  # True

    say ?(100 %% 3);   # False
    say 100 %% 3 != 0; # Falso

--- it/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/plural-ending/solution
    my $n = prompt 'Quanti file copiare? ';
    my $ending = $n == 1 ?? '' !! 's';
    say "$n file{$ending} copiati.";

--- it/essentials/functions/exercises/odd-or-even/solution

        $n %% 2 ?? 'Pari' !! 'Dispari'
    }

    say f(10);
    say f(5);
    say f(0);
    say f(3);

--- it/essentials/loops/loop

    loop (; $c < 5;) {
        say "Il valore attuale del contatore è $c.";
        $c++;
    }

--- it/essentials/loops/until

    until $x > 10 {
        $x = prompt 'Inserisci un numero, che non sia maggiore di 10: ';
        say "Hai inserito $x.";
    }
    say "$x è maggiore di 10.";

--- it/essentials/loops/while

    while $x <= 10 {

        say "Hai inserito $x.";
    }
    say "$x è maggiore di 10.";

    say $n ~~ $begin ..^ $end;

    say 3 != 4;      # True
    say 'a' !eq 'b'; # True  — non aequales ut fila

    say 'a' ne 'b'; # True — idem experimentum ac 'a' !eq 'b'

    say $common.elems; # 2
    say 2 ∈ $common;   # True

--- la/essentials/booleans/exercises/double-negation/solution
    my $valor = False;
    say !!$valor;

    $valor = True;
    say !!$valor;

--- la/essentials/booleans/exercises/tables/solution
    say 'Verum && Verum est ', True && True; 
    say 'Verum && Falsum est ', True && False;
    say 'Falsum && Verum est ', False && True;
    say 'Falsum && Falsum est ', False && False;

    say 'Verum || Verum est ', True || True; 
    say 'Verum || Falsum est ', True || False;
    say 'Falsum || Verum est ', False || True;
    say 'Falsum || Falsum est ', False || False;

    say 'Verum ^^ Verum est ', True ^^ True; 
    say 'Verum ^^ Falsum est ', True ^^ False;
    say 'Falsum ^^ Verum est ', False ^^ True;
    say 'Falsum ^^ Falsum est ', False ^^ False;

--- la/essentials/booleans/exercises/tables/solution
    say 'Verum && Verum est ' ~ (True && True);

--- la/essentials/built-in-functions-for-printing/exercises/compare-say-and-put/solution
    my Int $i = 42;
    say $i;
    put $i;

    my Rat $r = 3/4;
    say $r;
    put $r;

    my Num $n = 3e4;
    say $n;
    put $n;

    my Str $s = 'Raku';
    say $s;
    put $s;

    my @a = <hoc est array>;
    # say @a.WHAT;
    say @a;
    put @a;

    my List $l = <hoc est list>;
    # say $l.WHAT;
    say $l;
    put $l;

    my %h = A => 'alpha', B => 'beta';
    say %h;
    put %h;

--- la/essentials/conditional-checks/comparing-numbers
    say 10 == 10; # Verum
    say 10 != 10; # Falsum

    say 15 < 10;  # Falsum
    say 10 <= 10; # Verum
    say 16 > 10;  # Verum
    say 10 >= 14; # Falsum

    say 1.000000000000000000000001 =~= 1.000000000000000000000002; # Verum
    say 2e17 + 1 =~= 2e17 + 100; # Verum

--- la/essentials/conditional-checks/comparing-strings
    say 'alpha' lt 'beta'; # Verum
    say 'word' ne 'Word';  # True
    say 'xyz' gt 'xvw';    # Verum

    if 35.5 < $t < 37.5 {
        say 'Bene es.';
    }
    else {
        say 'Medicum voca, fortasse?';
    }

    if $x > 100 {
        say "$x maior est quam 100.";
    }
    elsif $x > 50 {
        say "$x maior est quam 50.";
    }
    elsif $x > 25 {
        say "$x maior est quam 25.";
    }
    else {
        say "$x est 25 vel minor.";
    }

--- la/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/how-many-equal-numbers/solution
    my $n1 = prompt 'Numerum 1 inserere: ';
    my $n2 = prompt 'Numerum 2 inserere: ';
    my $n3 = prompt 'Numerum 3 inserere: ';

    if $n1 == $n2 == $n3 {
        say 3;
    }
    elsif $n1 == $n2 || $n2 == $n3 || $n1 == $n3 {
        say 2;
    }
    else {
        say 0;
    }

--- la/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/leap-year/solution
    my $year = prompt 'Annus: ';

    if $year % 4 {
        say 'Annus communis';
    }
    elsif $year % 100 {
        say 'Annus bissextilis';
    }
    elsif $year % 400 {
        say 'Annus communis';
    }
    else {
        say 'Annus bissextilis';
    }

--- la/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/leap-year/solution
    my $year = prompt 'Annus: ';

    say (($year %% 400) || (($year %% 4) && ($year % 100))) ?? 'Annus bissextilis' !! 'Annus communis';

    say 100 %% 3 != 0; # Falsum

    }

--- la/essentials/conditional-checks/ternary-operator
    my $shines = 'Sol';
    my $tempus-diei = $shines eq 'Sol' ?? 'dies' !! 'nox';
    say $tempus-diei;

--- la/essentials/conditional-checks/ternary-operator
    my $horae = 20;
    my $tempus-diei =
        $horae <= 6 ?? 'Nox' !!
        $horae <= 12 ?? 'Mane' !! 
        $horae <= 18 ?? 'Postmeridianum' !! 'Vespera';
    say $tempus-diei;

--- la/essentials/conditional-checks/unless

    # ...Aliquid potest $broken ad Verum hic ponere...

        say "Noli sollicitari!";
        say "Esto laetus!";
    }

--- la/essentials/functions/default-values

        say "Salve, $nomen!";
    }

    saluta(nomen => 'Merinda'); # Salve, Merinda!
    saluta(); # Salve, Mundus!

--- la/essentials/functions/default-values

        say "$salutatio, $nomen!";
    }

    saluta(nomen => 'Alla'); # Salve, Alla!

--- la/oop/deleting
    mkdir 'reports';
    spurt 'reports/jan.txt', 'January';
    spurt 'reports/feb.txt', 'February';

    .unlink for 'reports'.IO.dir;   # omnem ingressum dele
    rmdir 'reports';                # nunc directoria vacua est
    say 'reports'.IO.e;             # False

--- la/oop/directories
    spurt 'greeting.txt', 'hi';

    say 'greeting.txt'.IO.e; # True  — exsistitne?
    say 'greeting.txt'.IO.f; # True  — estne archivum?
    say 'greeting.txt'.IO.d; # False — estne directoria?

--- la/oop/standard-streams
    say 'Hello'; # ad exitum vulgarem it

--- la/oop/standard-streams

--- la/paradigms/iterators/iterator-protocol
    my $it = <a b c>.iterator;
    loop {
        my $v := $it.pull-one;      # liga, ne assigna
        last if $v =:= IterationEnd;
        say $v;
    }

--- la/paradigms/junctions/autothreading
    say so all(3, 7, 2) > 0;  # True  — omnis valor positivus est
    say so all(3, -1, 2) > 0; # False — non omnes positivi sunt
    say so none(1, 2, 3) == 5; # True — nullus eorum est 5

--- la/paradigms/promises/making-a-promise
    my $p = Promise.new;   # promissum novum, nondum compositum

    $p.keep(42);           # imple illud valore
    say await $p;          # 42

--- la/paradigms/promises/promise-status
    my $p = start { die 'boom' };
    try await $p;         # sine illud componi (et errorem reiectum devora)
    say $p.status;        # Broken
    say $p.cause.message; # boom

--- la/paradigms/recursion/base-case
    sub countdown($n) {
        return if $n < 1;   # casus fundamentalis: consiste
        say $n;
        countdown($n - 1);  # gradus recursivus
    }

    countdown(3);

--- la/paradigms/supply-kinds/live-in-action
    my $supplier = Supplier.new;
    my $events   = $supplier.Supply;

    my $log = $events.tap(-> $v { say "log:   $v" });    # auditor primus adit
    $supplier.emit('start');

    my $alert = $events.tap(-> $v { say "alert: $v" });  # auditor secundus adit
    $supplier.emit('warning');
    $supplier.emit('all clear');

    $log.close;                                          # auditor primus abit
    $supplier.emit('stop');

--- lv/advanced/integers/number-bases
    say 0xFF;   # 255  — heksadecimālā (bāze 16)
    say 0b1010; # 10   — binārā (bāze 2)
    say 0o17;   # 15   — oktālā (bāze 8)

--- lv/advanced/introspection/what
    my $a = 42;
    my $b = 100;

    say $a.WHAT === $b.WHAT; # True  — abi ir Int
    say $a.WHAT === Int;     # True
    say $a.WHAT === Str;     # False

--- lv/advanced/quoting/adverbs
    say q/result: {3 * 4}/;   # result: {3 * 4}  — parasts q atstāj bloku neskartu
    say q:c/result: {3 * 4}/; # result: 12        — :c izpilda bloku

--- lv/advanced/quoting/q-qq-big-q
    say q{a\\b}; # a\b   — q saspiež aizēto atpakaļsvītru
    say Q{a\\b}; # a\\b  — Q saglabā abas rakstzīmes

--- lv/advanced/strings
    say 'raku'.uc; # RAKU  — lielie burti
    say 'RAKU'.lc; # raku  — mazie burti
    say 'raku'.tc; # Raku  — virsraksta reģistrs (pirmais burts lielais)

--- lv/advanced/strings/splitting
    say 'abc'.split('').elems;        # 5 — trīs burti, plus tukša virkne katrā galā
    say 'abc'.split('', :skip-empty); # (a b c) — adverbs :skip-empty izlaiž tukšos

--- lv/essentials/associatives/exercises/purchase-table/solution
    my @items = [
        {
            name => 'Krēsli',
            price => 20.57,
            quantity => 4,
        },
        {
            name => 'Galdi',
            price => 50.18,
            quantity => 1,
        }
    ];

    say "Prece\tCena\tN\tKopā";
    for @items -> $item {
        my $total = $item<price> * $item<quantity>;
        say "$item<name>\t\$$item<price>\t$item<quantity>\t\$$total";
    }

--- lv/essentials/associatives/exercises/salary-raise/solution
    my %employee =
        full-name => 'Eliza Vents',
        department => 'Sales',
        salary => 3000;

    my $raise = 5; # procentos

    %employee<salary> *= (1 + $raise / 100);
    say "Jaunā %employee<full-name> alga: %employee<salary>";

--- lv/essentials/booleans/exercises/tables/solution
    say 'True && True ir ', True && True; 
    say 'True && False ir ', True && False;
    say 'False && True ir ', False && True;
    say 'False && False ir ', False && False;

    say 'True || True ir ', True || True; 
    say 'True || False ir ', True || False;
    say 'False || True ir ', False || True;
    say 'False || False ir ', False || False;

    say 'True ^^ True ir ', True ^^ True; 
    say 'True ^^ False ir ', True ^^ False;
    say 'False ^^ True ir ', False ^^ True;
    say 'False ^^ False ir ', False ^^ False;

--- lv/essentials/booleans/exercises/tables/solution
    say 'True && True ir ' ~ (True && True);

--- lv/essentials/booleans/operations
    say False && True; # UN
    say False || True; # VAI
    say False ^^ True; # XOR

--- lv/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/fizz-buzz/solution

--- lv/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/how-many-equal-numbers/solution
    my $n1 = prompt 'Ievadiet skaitli 1: ';
    my $n2 = prompt 'Ievadiet skaitli 2: ';
    my $n3 = prompt 'Ievadiet skaitli 3: ';

    if $n1 == $n2 == $n3 {
        say 3;
    }
    elsif $n1 == $n2 || $n2 == $n3 || $n1 == $n3 {
        say 2;
    }
    else {
        say 0;
    }

--- lv/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/leap-year/solution
    my $year = prompt 'Gads: ';

    if $year % 4 {
        say 'Parastais gads';
    }
    elsif $year % 100 {
        say 'Garais gads';
    }
    elsif $year % 400 {
        say 'Parastais gads';
    }
    else {
        say 'Garais gads';
    }

--- lv/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/leap-year/solution
    my $year = prompt 'Gads: ';

    say (($year %% 400) || (($year %% 4) && ($year % 100))) ?? 'Garais gads' !! 'Parastais gads';

--- lv/paradigms/junctions/autothreading
    say so all(3, 7, 2) > 0;  # True  — katra vērtība ir pozitīva
    say so all(3, -1, 2) > 0; # False — ne visas ir pozitīvas
    say so none(1, 2, 3) == 5; # True — neviena no tām nav 5

--- lv/paradigms/promises/making-a-promise
    my $p = Promise.new;   # svaigs, nenokārtots solījums

    $p.keep(42);           # izpildām to ar vērtību
    say await $p;          # 42

--- lv/paradigms/promises/promise-status
    my $p = start { die 'boom' };
    try await $p;         # ļaujam tam nokārtoties (un norijam pārmesto kļūdu)
    say $p.status;        # Broken
    say $p.cause.message; # boom

--- lv/paradigms/supply-kinds/live-in-action
    my $supplier = Supplier.new;
    my $events   = $supplier.Supply;

    my $log = $events.tap(-> $v { say "log:   $v" });    # pievienojas pirmais klausītājs
    $supplier.emit('start');

    my $alert = $events.tap(-> $v { say "alert: $v" });  # pievienojas otrs klausītājs
    $supplier.emit('warning');
    $supplier.emit('all clear');

    $log.close;                                          # pirmais klausītājs aiziet
    $supplier.emit('stop');

--- nl/advanced/colon-calls
    my @a = 3, 1, 2;

    say @a.sort({ $^b <=> $^a }); # haakjes om het blok
    say @a.sort: { $^b <=> $^a }; # dubbele punt — geen sluithaakje nodig

--- nl/advanced/integers/number-bases
    say 0xFF;   # 255  — hexadecimaal (grondtal 16)
    say 0b1010; # 10   — binair (grondtal 2)
    say 0o17;   # 15   — octaal (grondtal 8)

--- nl/advanced/metaoperators/more
    say (1, 2, 3, 4) <<+>> (10, 20); # (11 22 13 24)  — 10, 20 herhaalt tot 10, 20, 10, 20

--- nl/advanced/metaoperators/more
    say 3 != 4;      # True
    say 'a' !eq 'b'; # True  — niet gelijk als tekenreeksen
    say 5 !%% 2;     # True  — 5 is niet deelbaar door 2

--- nl/advanced/metaoperators/more
    say 'a' ne 'b'; # True — dezelfde test als 'a' !eq 'b'

--- nl/advanced/quoting/adverbs
    say q/result: {3 * 4}/;   # result: {3 * 4}  — gewone q laat het blok onaangeroerd
    say q:c/result: {3 * 4}/; # result: 12        — :c voert het blok uit

--- nl/advanced/quoting/q-qq-big-q
    say q{a\\b}; # a\b   — q klapt de ge-escapete backslash samen
    say Q{a\\b}; # a\\b  — Q behoudt beide tekens

--- nl/advanced/sets-bags-mixes/operations
    my $common = set(1, 2, 3) ∩ set(2, 3, 4);
    say $common;       # Set(2 3) — merk op dat sets ongeordend zijn
    say $common.elems; # 2
    say 2 ∈ $common;   # True

--- nl/advanced/strings
    say 'raku'.uc; # RAKU  — hoofdletters
    say 'RAKU'.lc; # raku  — kleine letters
    say 'raku'.tc; # Raku  — beginhoofdletter

--- nl/advanced/strings/splitting
    say 'abc'.split('').elems;        # 5 — de drie letters, plus aan elk uiteinde een lege string
    say 'abc'.split('', :skip-empty); # (a b c) — het bijwoord :skip-empty laat de lege weg

--- nl/advanced/traits-pragmas/built-in-traits
    sub greet($name is copy) {
        $name = "dear $name";
        say "Hello, $name!";
    }

    my $who = 'Anna';
    greet($who); # Hello, dear Anna!
    say $who;    # Anna — de variabele van de aanroeper blijft ongemoeid

--- nl/advanced/whatever

    say (1..*).head(3); # (1 2 3)  — 1..* is een open bereik

--- nl/essentials/associatives/exercises/purchase-table/solution
    my @items = [
        {
            name => 'Stoelen',
            price => 20.57,
            quantity => 4,
        },
        {
            name => 'Tafels',
            price => 50.18,
            quantity => 1,
        }
    ];

    say "Artikel\tPrijs\tAantal\tTotaal";
    for @items -> $item {
        my $total = $item<price> * $item<quantity>;
        say "$item<name>\t\$$item<price>\t$item<quantity>\t\$$total";
    }

--- nl/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/fizz-buzz/solution

--- nl/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/how-many-equal-numbers/solution
    my $n1 = prompt 'Voer nummer 1 in: ';
    my $n2 = prompt 'Voer nummer 2 in: ';
    my $n3 = prompt 'Voer nummer 3 in: ';

    if $n1 == $n2 == $n3 {
        say 3;
    }
    elsif $n1 == $n2 || $n2 == $n3 || $n1 == $n3 {
        say 2;
    }
    else {
        say 0;
    }

--- ru/advanced/sets-bags-mixes/operations

    say $common;       # Set(2 3) — обратите внимание, что множества неупорядочены
    say $common.elems; # 2
    say 2 ∈ $common;   # True

--- ru/oop/deleting
    mkdir 'reports';
    spurt 'reports/jan.txt', 'January';
    spurt 'reports/feb.txt', 'February';

    .unlink for 'reports'.IO.dir;   # удаляем все записи
    rmdir 'reports';                # теперь каталог пуст
    say 'reports'.IO.e;             # False

--- ru/oop/directories
    spurt 'greeting.txt', 'hi';

    say 'greeting.txt'.IO.e; # True  — существует ли?
    say 'greeting.txt'.IO.f; # True  — это файл?
    say 'greeting.txt'.IO.d; # False — это каталог?

--- ru/paradigms/iterators/iterator-protocol
    my $it = <a b c>.iterator;
    loop {
        my $v := $it.pull-one;      # связываем, а не присваиваем
        last if $v =:= IterationEnd;
        say $v;
    }

--- ru/paradigms/junctions/autothreading
    say so all(3, 7, 2) > 0;  # True  — каждое значение положительно
    say so all(3, -1, 2) > 0; # False — не все положительны
    say so none(1, 2, 3) == 5; # True — ни одно из них не равно 5

--- ru/paradigms/promises/making-a-promise
    my $p = Promise.new;   # свежий, ещё не улаженный промис

    say await $p;          # 42

--- ru/paradigms/promises/promise-status
    my $p = start { die 'boom' };
    try await $p;         # даём ему уладиться (и проглатываем заново брошенную ошибку)
    say $p.status;        # Broken
    say $p.cause.message; # boom

--- ru/paradigms/recursion/base-case
    sub countdown($n) {
        return if $n < 1;   # базовый случай: останавливаемся
        say $n;
        countdown($n - 1);  # рекурсивный шаг
    }

    countdown(3);

--- ru/paradigms/supply-kinds/live-in-action
    my $supplier = Supplier.new;
    my $events   = $supplier.Supply;

    my $log = $events.tap(-> $v { say "log:   $v" });    # присоединяется первый слушатель
    $supplier.emit('start');

    my $alert = $events.tap(-> $v { say "alert: $v" });  # присоединяется второй слушатель
    $supplier.emit('warning');
    $supplier.emit('all clear');

    $log.close;                                          # первый слушатель уходит
    $supplier.emit('stop');

--- uk/advanced/colon-calls
    my @a = 3, 1, 2;

    say @a.sort({ $^b <=> $^a }); # дужки навколо блоку
    say @a.sort: { $^b <=> $^a }; # двокрапка — закривальну дужку шукати не треба

--- uk/advanced/contexts/coercion-contexts
    my @a = 1, 2, 3;

    say 10 + @a;              # 13, тут @a це його довжина: 3
    say 'items: ' ~ @a;       # items: 1 2 3
    if @a { say 'not empty' } # not empty

--- uk/advanced/integers/number-bases
    say 0xFF;   # 255  — шістнадцяткова (основа 16)
    say 0b1010; # 10   — двійкова (основа 2)
    say 0o17;   # 15   — вісімкова (основа 8)

--- uk/advanced/introspection/what
    my $a = 42;
    my $b = 100;

    say $a.WHAT === $b.WHAT; # True  — обидва Int
    say $a.WHAT === Int;     # True
    say $a.WHAT === Str;     # False

--- uk/advanced/metaoperators/more
    say (1, 2, 3, 4) <<+>> (10, 20); # (11 22 13 24)  — 10, 20 повторюється як 10, 20, 10, 20

--- uk/advanced/metaoperators/more
    say 3 != 4;      # True
    say 'a' !eq 'b'; # True  — не рівні як рядки
    say 5 !%% 2;     # True  — 5 не ділиться на 2

--- uk/advanced/metaoperators/more
    say 'a' ne 'b'; # True — та сама перевірка, що й 'a' !eq 'b'

--- uk/advanced/ordered-containers/binding
    my $x = 10;
    my $y = $x; # звичайна копія

    $x = 20;
    say $y; # 10

--- uk/advanced/packages/namespaces
    module Counter {
        our $count = 0;  # змінна пакунка
        my  $secret = 42; # лексична, ззовні не видима
    }

    say $Counter::count; # 0

--- uk/advanced/quoting/adverbs
    say q/result: {3 * 4}/;   # result: {3 * 4}  — звичайний q залишає блок недоторканим
    say q:c/result: {3 * 4}/; # result: 12        — :c виконує блок

--- uk/advanced/quoting/q-qq-big-q
    say qq{line\nbreak}; # line<новий рядок>break
    say q{line\nbreak};  # line\nbreak
    say Q{line\nbreak};  # line\nbreak

--- uk/advanced/quoting/q-qq-big-q
    say q{a\\b}; # a\b   — q згортає екрановану зворотну косу риску
    say Q{a\\b}; # a\\b  — Q зберігає обидва символи

--- uk/advanced/scalar-containers/type-constraints
    my Int $int;

    $int = 123;       # безпосередньо ціле число
    say $int;

    $int = 100 + 23;  # результат є цілим числом
    say $int;

    $int = '123'.Int; # рядок, перетворений на ціле число
    say $int;

--- uk/advanced/sets-bags-mixes/operations
    my $common = set(1, 2, 3) ∩ set(2, 3, 4);
    say $common;       # Set(2 3) — зверніть увагу, що множини невпорядковані
    say $common.elems; # 2
    say 2 ∈ $common;   # True

--- uk/advanced/special-variables/built-in
    $*OUT.say('normal output'); # іде в стандартний вивід
    $*ERR.say('a diagnostic');  # іде в стандартний потік помилок

--- uk/advanced/statement-prefixes/sink-quietly
    my $value;
    quietly {
        say $value + 1; # 1, без попередження "uninitialized value"
    }

--- uk/advanced/strings
    say 'raku'.uc; # RAKU  — верхній регістр
    say 'RAKU'.lc; # raku  — нижній регістр
    say 'raku'.tc; # Raku  — заголовний регістр (перша літера велика)

--- uk/advanced/strings/splitting
    say 'abc'.split('').elems;        # 5 — три літери плюс порожній рядок з кожного боку
    say 'abc'.split('', :skip-empty); # (a b c) — наріччя :skip-empty відкидає порожні

--- uk/advanced/traits-pragmas/built-in-traits
    sub greet($name is copy) {
        $name = "dear $name";
        say "Hello, $name!";
    }

    my $who = 'Anna';
    greet($who); # Hello, dear Anna!
    say $who;    # Anna — власна змінна викликача недоторкана

--- uk/advanced/whatever
    my @a = 10, 20, 30;
    say @a[*-1];        # 30  — * це довжина масиву, тож *-1 це останній індекс

    say (1..*).head(3); # (1 2 3)  — 1..* це відкритий діапазон

--- uk/essentials/associatives/interpolating-hashes
    my %data = FR => 'Paris', IT => 'Rome';

    say "%data<>";

    # Або:
    # say "%data{}";

    print @data;

    print "\n"; # Щоб розділити частини

    my %data = alpha => 1, beta => 2, gamma => 3;
    print %data;

    #`( Ми збираємося попросити користувача
    ввести своє ім'я спочатку, а потім
    зберегти введення в змінну. )

--- uk/essentials/conditional-checks/else

    if 35.5 < $t < 37.5 {
        say 'У вас все добре.';
    }
    else {
        say 'Можливо, зверніться до лікаря?';
    }

--- uk/essentials/conditional-checks/elsif
    my $x = prompt 'Введіть число: ';
    if $x > 100 {
        say "$x більше за 100.";
    }
    elsif $x > 50 {
        say "$x більше за 50.";
    }
    elsif $x > 25 {
        say "$x більше за 25.";
    }
    else {
        say "$x дорівнює 25 або менше.";
    }

--- uk/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/fizz-buzz/solution
    my $n = prompt 'Введіть число: ';

    print 'Fizz' if $n %% 3;
    print 'Buzz' if $n %% 5;
    print "\n";

--- uk/essentials/conditional-checks/exercises/how-many-equal-numbers/solution
    my $n1 = prompt 'Введіть число 1: ';
    my $n2 = prompt 'Введіть число 2: ';
    my $n3 = prompt 'Введіть число 3: ';

    if $n1 == $n2 == $n3 {
        say 3;
    }
    elsif $n1 == $n2 || $n2 == $n3 || $n1 == $n3 {
        say 2;
    }
    else {
        say 0;
    }

    }

    say f(5);
    say f(0);
    say f(3);

    my $end = prompt 'Кінець: ';

        say $n;
    }

--- uk/oop/deleting
    mkdir 'reports';
    spurt 'reports/jan.txt', 'January';
    spurt 'reports/feb.txt', 'February';

    .unlink for 'reports'.IO.dir;   # видалити кожен запис
    rmdir 'reports';                # тепер каталог порожній
    say 'reports'.IO.e;             # False

--- uk/oop/directories
    spurt 'greeting.txt', 'hi';

    say 'greeting.txt'.IO.e; # True  — чи існує?
    say 'greeting.txt'.IO.f; # True  — чи це файл?
    say 'greeting.txt'.IO.d; # False — чи це каталог?

--- uk/paradigms/iterators/iterator-protocol
    my $it = <a b c>.iterator;
    loop {
        my $v := $it.pull-one;      # зв'язування, а не присвоєння
        last if $v =:= IterationEnd;
        say $v;
    }

--- uk/paradigms/junctions/autothreading
    say so all(3, 7, 2) > 0;  # True  — кожне значення додатне
    say so all(3, -1, 2) > 0; # False — не всі додатні
    say so none(1, 2, 3) == 5; # True — жодне з них не дорівнює 5

--- uk/paradigms/promises/making-a-promise
    my $p = Promise.new;   # свіжа, невладнана обіцянка

    $p.keep(42);           # виконуємо її зі значенням
    say await $p;          # 42

--- uk/paradigms/promises/promise-status
    my $p = start { die 'boom' };
    try await $p;         # даємо їй владнатися (і ковтаємо повторно кинуту помилку)
    say $p.status;        # Broken
    say $p.cause.message; # boom

--- uk/paradigms/recursion/base-case
    sub countdown($n) {
        return if $n < 1;   # базовий випадок: зупинка
        say $n;
        countdown($n - 1);  # рекурсивний крок
    }

    countdown(3);

--- uk/paradigms/supply-kinds/live-in-action
    my $supplier = Supplier.new;
    my $events   = $supplier.Supply;

    my $log = $events.tap(-> $v { say "log:   $v" });    # приєднується перший слухач
    $supplier.emit('start');

    my $alert = $events.tap(-> $v { say "alert: $v" });  # приєднується другий слухач
    $supplier.emit('warning');
    $supplier.emit('all clear');

    $log.close;                                          # перший слухач іде
    $supplier.emit('stop');
